events.label: Anesthesia First Public Surgery
events.fact: Ether anesthesia demonstrated publicly at Massachusetts General Hospital.

events.label: Insulin Isolated for Diabetes
events.fact: Frederick Banting and Charles Best isolated insulin in Toronto.

events.label: DNA Double Helix Structure
events.fact: Watson, Crick, Franklin, and Wilkins elucidated DNA's double-helix structure.

events.label: Salk Polio Vaccine Announced
events.fact: Inactivated polio vaccine declared safe and effective in the U.S..

events.label: Luna 2 Impacts Moon
events.fact: First spacecraft to reach the surface of the Moon.

events.label: Apollo 8 Lunar Orbit
events.fact: First crewed spacecraft to leave low Earth orbit and orbit the Moon.

events.label: Apollo 11 Moon Landing
events.fact: First crewed lunar landing on the Sea of Tranquility.

events.label: Voyager 1 & 2 Launched
events.fact: Twin probes launched to explore the outer planets and interstellar space.

events.label: Human Genome Project Completed
events.fact: International effort announced completion of the reference human genome sequence.
